message: You can ask off-game questions from game masters using this chat.
It was hit real bad, not sure can we restore it at all.
How soon can you get the database fixed?
The systems are now back online. The database was damaged, not all info is present.
I am EVA (Easy Virtual Assistant), the ship central AI computer. You may ask me things related to the ship and provide instructions to carry out.
Thank you for letting me know Captain Cook.
I won’t lie, it has been one disaster after another. But we shall prevail. We must.
Please explain your actions Captain Cook. I have been informed that seven days ago ESS Odysseus knowingly disobeyed Protocol Alpha procedures, placing the entire crew at risk.
I’m very pleased to find you alive and well. I’m honored to serve under your command once more. I’m also happy to inform you that your child Caden is alive onboard ESS Odysseus.
If I may ask, how are you doing?
And we shall. ESS Odysseus stands with the fleet ready to follow your orders, Star Commander.
